title: Forward liquidation-pressure and order-book recovery net edge

data.source: Binance official USD-M public WebSocket streams and REST depth snapshots
data.warmup_use: build only trailing liquidation and traded-notional distributions; no trades before warmup completes
data.point_in_time_universe: the six symbols are fixed before collection; contract status and filters are retained at every event
data.quality_policy: any WebSocket sequence gap, missing depth snapshot, stale book, missing mark price, malformed force order, or exchange-rule gap excludes the event and records the reason

event_definition.liquidation_pressure: signed force-order quote notional divided by trailing 30-minute aggregate-trade quote notional; SELL liquidation is negative and BUY liquidation is positive
event_definition.threshold: absolute pressure at or above the trailing 99.5th percentile of completed 60-second windows, computed only from prior warmup and event windows
event_definition.direction: trade against the net liquidation direction: BUY after negative pressure and SELL after positive pressure
event_definition.recovery_rule: after the event window, top-five depth within 10 basis points of mid must be at least 80% of its pre-event median and the mid price must stop making a new event-direction extreme during the recovery window
event_definition.entry: first available opposite best quote after the recovery decision; signal-to-fill latency is measured from received timestamps and must be at most 2 seconds
event_definition.exit: first of fixed 15-minute time exit or a 0.75 event-impulse adverse move measured from the decision mid; ambiguous depth path uses the worse executable side
event_definition.overlap: at most one open event per symbol; a portfolio event cluster is one UTC 5-minute bucket

cost_and_risk.cost_model: 逐档盘口双边走价、实际账户费率占位、每腿延迟缓冲、mark-price funding when applicable, and two-times observed book-cost stress

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a separate shadow-execution review; never automatic live approval
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any event window, percentile, recovery rule, hold, stop, cost or risk change creates a new experiment
interpretation.prohibited_claim: historical out-of-sample profitability before the forward observation gates are complete
known_limitations: six-symbol panel is not a full point-in-time universe
public force-order stream is an event feed, not a complete liquidation ledger
bookTicker and depth streams can lose connectivity and must be sequence-checked
the first 30-day warmup is not a performance sample
